observation.command: cd /tmp && rm -f cj.txt && T=$(curl -s -c cj.txt http://127.0.0.1:3000/users/sign_in | grep -o 'name="authenticity_token" value="[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//'); curl -s -b cj.txt -c cj.txt -o /dev/null -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/users/sign_in --data-urlencode "authenticity_token=$T" --data-urlencode "user[login]=verified@consul.dev" --data-urlencode "user[password]=Aa12345678"; echo "--- new proposal form ---"; curl -s -b cj.txt http://127.0.0.1:3000/proposals/new -o form.html -w "form=%{http_code}\n"; grep -o 'name="proposal\[[^]]*\]"' form.html | sort -u | head -20
